_about: The trip that has been travelled: a plan, closed as completed, with its packing list ticked off, routes for its walks and the bookings attached to its places; and a report copied from it with how every place turned out, what was really spent, the recordings of the walks, photographs on the days and places - favourites among many at one beach, one private, one without a time - covers, and a Russian translation that leaves some days and places untranslated.
title: Iceland: the south coast
summary: Four days along route 1, from Reykjavík to Vík and back. Waterfalls, black sand and one very windy afternoon.

stays.name: Guesthouse Hraun
stays.notes_md: Parking behind the house. The key is in the box, code in the email.

stays.name: Vík Sea View
stays.notes_md: Breakfast from 07:30. Ask for a room facing the sea.

transfers.name: Icelandair FI 205
transfers.notes_md: One checked bag each. Seats 14A and 14B.

days.title: Reykjavík to Hvolsvöllur
days.notes_md: Pick the car up at the airport and take route 1 east, with one walk on the way: the warm river above Hveragerði. The point is still to be at the guesthouse before the shop closes.

places.name: Keflavík airport
places.description_md: Car hire desk is in the arrivals hall, on the right. **Bring the booking number.**

report.story_md: The queue took half an hour; the car had a scratch we photographed.

attachments.description: Print it: the desk wants paper, not a phone

places.name: Reykjadalur hot river
places.description_md: Up the valley to the warm stream and bathe where the boardwalk is. **Swimsuit and a towel.**

report.story_md: Steam everywhere, sheep on the path and a river exactly the temperature of a bath.

places.name: Seljalandsfoss
places.description_md: The path goes *behind* the waterfall. Waterproofs, not umbrellas.

report.story_md: Soaked through in two minutes and worth every bit of it. Go early or late; at three it was full.

places.name: Gljúfrabúi
places.description_md: Hidden in a cleft a few minutes' walk north. Wet feet guaranteed.

report.story_md: Ran out of daylight and patience for wet socks.

days.title: Waterfalls and the plane wreck
days.notes_md: The long day. Start early - the wreck is a 45-minute walk each way from the car park.

places.name: Skógafoss
places.description_md: 527 steps to the top. The view back down the valley is the reason.

report.story_md: Climbed the steps before the buses arrived. Wind at the top took the hat.

places.name: Sólheimasandur plane wreck
places.description_md: Flat black sand, no shade, no shelter. Two hours there and back.

report.story_md: A long walk for a photograph everyone already has. The sand is the memorable part.

places.name: Dyrhólaey
places.description_md: Puffins on the cliffs in June. The upper road closes in bad weather.

report.story_md: Closed for the evening because of the wind.

days.title: Vík and the black beach
days.notes_md: Move to Vík. Short driving day, so there is time to sit still for once.

places.name: Reynisfjara
places.description_md: **Do not turn your back on the sea.** The sneaker waves here are lethal.

report.story_md: Stood well back and watched the water for an hour. The basalt columns do not photograph.

places.name: Suður-Vík
places.description_md: Booked for two. The lamb soup is the thing.

report.story_md: The soup lived up to it. Two beers made it dearer than planned.

days.title: Back to Keflavík
days.notes_md: Straight back, with one stop. Flight is at 17:40, car back by 15:30.

places.name: Kvernufoss
places.description_md: The quiet one. Fifteen minutes' walk from the museum car park.

report.story_md: Nobody there. The best half hour of the trip, and it was the afterthought.

places.name: Keflavík airport
places.description_md: Fuel the car at the station before the turn-off; the airport one costs more.

report.story_md: Scratch was already on the form. No argument.

attachments.description: Signed at the desk, no extra charges

unassigned.name: Fjaðrárgljúfur
unassigned.description_md: Two hours further east than we are going. Next time.

unassigned.name: Blue Lagoon
unassigned.description_md: Only worth it on the way to the airport, and only if booked weeks ahead.

legs.note: Tunnel toll on the way out of the peninsula.
The walk out to the wreck and back; no road.

report.intro_md:
# Four days on route 1

We went for the waterfalls and stayed for the wind. Everything below is what actually happened, including the two things we did not do.
report.summary_md:
## Worth knowing

- The weather decides the itinerary, not the itinerary.
- The quiet waterfall we almost skipped was the best of them.
- Budget more for food than seems reasonable.

day_notes.1: Landed late, queued for the car, and still made the guesthouse in daylight. June helps with that.
day_notes.2: The long day, and it earned the name. Two waterfalls, one very long walk on black sand, and a cliff road closed by wind.
day_notes.4: Left early, stopped once, and were glad we did.

unplanned.name: Vík wool shop
unplanned.description_md: Walked past it twice and went in the third time.

report.story_md: Not planned, not regretted. The jumper has been worn ever since.

translation.title: Исландия: южное побережье
translation.summary: Четыре дня по первой трассе, от Рейкьявика до Вика и обратно. Водопады, чёрный песок и один очень ветреный день.
translation.intro_md:
# Четыре дня по первой трассе

Ехали за водопадами, а запомнили ветер. Ниже - то, что было на самом деле, включая два места, до которых мы не добрались.
translation.summary_md:
## Что стоит знать

- Маршрут определяет погода, а не план.
- Тихий водопад, который мы чуть не пропустили, оказался лучшим.
- На еду закладывайте больше, чем кажется разумным.

day_notes.1: Прилетели поздно, отстояли очередь за машиной и всё равно добрались засветло. В июне это нетрудно.
day_notes.2: Самый длинный день, и он это название заслужил. Два водопада, долгая прогулка по чёрному песку и дорога на утёс, закрытая из-за ветра.

Kvernufoss.name: Квернюфосс
Kvernufoss.story_md: Ни души. Лучшие полчаса поездки, а ведь заехали туда между делом.

Reynisfjara.name: Рейнисфьяра
Reynisfjara.description_md: **Не поворачивайтесь к морю спиной.** Внезапные волны здесь смертельно опасны.
Reynisfjara.story_md: Стояли подальше и час смотрели на воду. Базальтовые столбы на фото не передать.

Seljalandsfoss.name: Сельяландсфосс
Seljalandsfoss.description_md: Тропа проходит *за* водопадом. Нужен дождевик, а не зонт.
Seljalandsfoss.story_md: Промокли за две минуты, и оно того стоило. Приезжайте рано или поздно: в три часа там не протолкнуться.

Skógafoss.name: Скоугафосс
Skógafoss.story_md: Поднялись по ступеням до автобусов. Наверху ветер унёс шапку.

Reykjadalur hot river.name: Горячая река Рейкьядалюр
Reykjadalur hot river.story_md: Пар повсюду, овцы на тропе и река ровно той температуры, что ванна.

day_highlights.1: Купание в тёплой реке, пока пар стекал по долине.
Bathing in a warm river while the steam rolled down the valley.
day_highlights.3: Waves racing up the black sand faster than anyone could run.

items.name: Sleep mask
items.note: It does not get dark in June
